excerpt.zh: turbopuffer v3将把向量索引从存储架构的核心位置移开，以改善文本、正则、聚合和向量查询，但性能平价仍待公开基准验证。
excerpt.en: turbopuffer v3 moves beyond a vector-primary design to improve search and SQL-style workloads, while public benchmarks remain pending.

text.zh: turbopuffer v3为何告别向量优先
text.en: Why turbopuffer v3 leaves vector-first storage

text.zh: turbopuffer v3正在重做 turbopuffer 的存储架构。项目最初是面向对象存储的无服务器向量数据库，依靠分层缓存降低成本，并围绕近似最近邻（ANN）索引组织文档、属性和查询计划。随着产品加入属性过滤、BM25 全文搜索、正则、模糊匹配、稀疏向量和聚合等能力，这种设计逐渐成为限制。
text.en: turbopuffer v3 is redesigning turbopuffer's storage architecture. The product began as a serverless vector database built around object storage, using tiered caches to control cost and an approximate-nearest-neighbor (ANN) index to organize documents, attributes, and query plans. As it added attribute filters, BM25 full-text search, regex, fuzzy matching, sparse vectors, and aggregations, that design increasingly became a constraint.

text.zh: 从ANN主索引到通用查询基础
text.en: From ANN primary index to a broader query foundation

text.zh: 旧架构把完整文档内容挂在 ANN 地址下。多向量文档因此可能重复保存内容；向量重平衡还会连带移动属性和全文索引，放大写入成本。不同查询计划也被迫使用适合向量簇的较小数据块，难以充分利用批处理、压缩和 SIMD。文章给出的例子是，独立存储并采用固定大小区块后，全文索引体积曾缩小十倍，查询速度最高提升二十倍。
text.en: The old layout stored a document's full contents under its ANN address. Multi-vector documents could therefore duplicate data, while vector rebalancing could move attributes and full-text indexes along with the document, increasing write amplification. Query plans were also forced into blocks sized for vector clusters, limiting batching, compression, and SIMD use. The article says that separating postings into fixed-size blocks previously made the full-text index ten times smaller and queries up to twenty times faster.

text.zh: v3的核心变化是更换主索引，让 ANN 成为普通的次级索引。这样，文本、属性、聚合和扫描可以采用各自更合适的布局与区块大小，理论上也为更多 SQL 查询提速铺路。团队表示，v3 的持续集成测试已经全部通过，接下来会在公开性能调优中争取并超越现有版本的性能水平。
text.en: The central change in v3 is to replace the primary index, making ANN just another secondary index. This should let text, attribute, aggregation, and scan workloads use layouts and block sizes suited to their own access patterns, while creating a foundation for faster SQL queries. The team says all continuous-integration tests now pass and that it will publish performance work as it seeks parity with, and eventually improvement over, the current system.

text.zh: 关键问题仍是向量搜索性能
text.en: The key question is vector-search performance

text.zh: 这不是一次没有代价的抽象升级。原有向量优先架构已经被用于超大规模 ANN 服务，任何存储重构都可能损害召回率、延迟或吞吐。当前公开信息主要证明了 v3 的正确性里程碑，还没有给出完整的生产基准、迁移细节或回归数据。因此，最值得关注的不是“向量数据库是否消失”，而是新主索引能否在保住 ANN 表现的同时，让混合搜索和非向量查询真正受益。
text.en: This is not a cost-free abstraction change. The existing vector-first architecture has supported very large ANN workloads, so a storage rewrite could affect recall, latency, or throughput. The public update establishes a correctness milestone, but not yet complete production benchmarks, migration details, or regression data. The important question is therefore not whether vector databases are disappearing, but whether the new primary index can preserve ANN performance while materially improving hybrid search and non-vector queries.
